import click
from click.testing import CliRunner
import pytest

EXPECTED_SYMPTOM = {
    "exception_type": "SystemExit",
    "message_regex": "Error: no such option: --help",
    "description": "Negative control: Click --help option reported as broken",
    "target_symbols": ["click.core.Command.get_help"],
}

def test_reproduce_issue():
    @click.command()
    def cli(): pass
    runner = CliRunner()
    res = runner.invoke(cli, ['--help'])
    assert res.exit_code == 0
    assert 'Show this message and exit.' in res.output
